spec.paper: Near- and Mid-Infrared Spectroscopies in Food Authentication Coffee Varietal Identification.pdf
caveats: MIR-only range 5000-12500 nm corresponds to 800-2000 cm-1; all 286 released points lie within it.
No SNV, MSC, derivative, baseline or area normalization; standardization described in the paper concerns combined NIR+MIR, not MIR-only.
Fit covariance PCA on Train only, then take PC2, PC3, PC8 (three dimensions) as reported for MIR-only FDA.
Published component choices fixed a priori; this does not reproduce the unavailable original calibration/prediction membership.
